name: Foosha Village
summary: A quiet windmill village on Dawn Island in East Blue, where Luffy grew up.

name: Shells Town
summary: An East Blue port town with a Marine base, run with an iron fist by its captain.

name: Orange Town
summary: A small harbor town in East Blue. When Luffy turns up, Buggy the Clown’s pirates have taken it over and its people have fled.

name: Syrup Village
summary: A peaceful village on the Gecko Islands in East Blue, and Usopp’s hometown.

name: Island of Rare Animals
summary: A small East Blue island full of strange hybrid animals, guarded by a man stuck in a treasure chest.

name: Baratie
summary: A restaurant ship out on the sea near the Grand Line, run by Chef Zeff, whose cooks are as rough as their customers.

name: Arlong Park
summary: The seaside fortress of Arlong’s Fish-Man pirates, built to rule the Conomi Islands.

name: Loguetown
summary: The town where the Pirate King was born and executed, and the last big port before the Grand Line.

name: Warship Island
summary: An island shaped like a battleship, and Apis’s home.

name: Reverse Mountain
summary: A mountain on the Red Line whose currents run uphill from the four Blues and spill down into the Grand Line. It’s the usual way in for ships from the Blues.

name: Twin Cape
summary: The cape at the foot of Reverse Mountain, where the Grand Line begins. An old doctor keeps the lighthouse.

name: Whisky Peak
summary: A town on Cactus Island, the first stop for many ships on the Grand Line, known for welcoming pirates with open arms.

name: Little Garden
summary: A jungle island in Paradise whose ancient climate has kept dinosaurs alive.

name: Drum Island
summary: A snow-covered winter island in Paradise, home to the Drum Kingdom and the castle on its highest mountain.

name: Arabasta
summary: A vast desert kingdom in Paradise and Princess Vivi’s home, where the rain has stopped falling.

name: Goat Island
summary: An uncharted island hidden in fog and reefs, home to an old man and his goats.

name: Ruluka Island
summary: An island in Paradise whose waters hide a strange phenomenon, the Rainbow Mist.

name: Jaya
summary: An island in Paradise with no law at all, whose harbor, Mock Town, is crowded with rowdy pirates.

name: Skypiea
summary: A country high in the sky above Paradise, where the islands are made of cloud and the sea is white.

name: Navarone
summary: An island fortress in Paradise, home to Marine Base G-8 and walled in by sheer cliffs.

name: Long Ring Long Land
summary: A chain of islands in Paradise where everything, from trees to horses to people, grows extra long.

name: Water 7
summary: A city of canals and fountains in Paradise, famous for its shipwrights and home to the shipbuilding company Galley-La.

name: Enies Lobby
summary: The World Government’s judicial island, where the sun never sets and prisoners are sent on through the Gates of Justice.

name: Lovely Land
summary: The icy headquarters of the Accino Family, a band of bounty hunters, hidden in a sea of icebergs.

name: Thriller Bark
summary: A ship the size of an island, lurking in the fog of the Florian Triangle, a stretch of sea where ships disappear.

name: Spa Island
summary: A floating resort of hot springs, pools, and slides, a place to rest after the Florian Triangle.

name: Sabaody Archipelago
summary: A forest of giant mangrove trees near the Red Line, the last stop in Paradise, where ships are coated to sail down to Fish-Man Island.

name: Amazon Lily
summary: A Calm Belt island ruled by the Kuja, a tribe of warrior women, where men are forbidden.

name: Impel Down
summary: The World Government’s undersea prison for its most dangerous criminals, sunk deep beneath the Calm Belt.

name: Little East Blue
summary: An island settled by people from East Blue, far from their home sea.

name: Marineford
summary: The home of Marine Headquarters: a fortress town on the Grand Line, close to Mary Geoise and Sabaody, reached through the Gates of Justice.

name: Rusukaina
summary: A harsh Calm Belt island near Amazon Lily, where the weather cycles through a new season every week or so.

name: Fish-Man Island
summary: An undersea kingdom ten thousand meters down, home to Fish-Men and merfolk, and a way into the New World beneath the Red Line.

name: Punk Hazard
summary: A forbidden New World island, scorching on one side and frozen solid on the other.

name: Dressrosa
summary: A New World kingdom of flowers, passion, and toys, ruled by the Warlord Donquixote Doflamingo.

name: Silver Mine
summary: A deserted New World island near Dressrosa, honeycombed by a silver mine and the fortress built over it.

name: Zou
summary: An island that rides on a thousand-year-old elephant as it wades through the New World, home to the Mink Tribe.

name: Whole Cake Island
summary: The heart of Totto Land, the island nation ruled by Big Mom, one of the Four Emperors, where much of the land is good enough to eat.

name: Mary Geoise
summary: The World Government’s capital, perched high on the Red Line, where the world’s highest nobles live.

name: Wano Country
summary: An island nation of samurai in the New World, closed off from the rest of the world behind towering cliffs and waterfalls.

name: Egghead
summary: A New World winter island that the scientist Dr. Vegapunk turned into a laboratory city, built to be five hundred years ahead of its time.

name: Elbaph
summary: The homeland of the giants, a fiercely independent nation in the New World famed for its warriors.
